detail.longDescription: I’ve always believed that AI should work alongside people, not just behind the scenes. People don’t want to just let AI make every decision for them in the background. They want to interact with it, take control, and hand things off whenever they choose. i) Tyche is an intelligent browser that does what you ask. It clicks, books, fills out forms, shops, summarizes, and scrolls, right on the web pages you already use. ii) Browse on your own or with the agent. Switch tabs anytime, and pick up any page or chat right where you left off. iii) Introducing Tyche. Now available on the U.S. App Store.
